notes: Primary sources: Marshall's own cutsheet (https://marshall-usa.com/pdf/CV630-IP-cutsheet.pdf) and full user manual (https://marshall-usa.com/pdf/CV630-IP_Manual.pdf), Chapter 3.1 "I/O Functions Introduction" rear-panel table, cross-checked against the product page (https://marshall-usa.com/cameras/CV630-IP/). Desktop/tabletop PTZ camera (ceiling-mountable via optional bracket) — rackUnits omitted, not rack-mountable. Model sold in black (CV630-IP) and white (CV630-IPW) variants with identical I/O; this entry covers the shared connector layout. RS-232 IN/OUT physically use 8-pin mini-DIN connectors (not DE-9); "rs232" was the closest available connector id since mini-DIN is not in the enum. RS-422 uses a 9-pin captive terminal-block connector, supplied as a separate plug-in accessory in the box; "rs422" chosen as connector id though physically it is a euroblock-style pluggable terminal, not a D-sub. Ethernet grade (eth-1g) is inferred/not explicitly confirmed by the manufacturer — spec sheet states "Ethernet" with PoE+ (802.3at) but does not print a link-speed number, so treat this grade as medium confidence. HDMI version/number is not stated by Marshall for this model, so no HDMI grade was set. IR receiver and IR Select switch exist on the unit but are not modeled as a physical AV signal/power port. Front tally light and power/standby LEDs are indicators, not connectors, and were omitted.

ports.name: HDMI OUT
ports.note: Full-size HDMI output, embedded audio supported; HDMI version not stated by manufacturer

ports.name: ETHERNET
ports.note: PoE+ (IEEE 802.3at); carries IP video (HEVC/H.264), VISCA-IP/ONVIF control, and power. Manufacturer does not explicitly state Gigabit; 1G inferred as standard for PoE+ IP camera of this class carrying 4K streams

ports.name: AUDIO IN
ports.note: Stereo, switchable mic or line level

ports.name: RS-232 IN
ports.note: 8-pin mini-DIN connector (closest listed connector id used; physical connector is mini-DIN, not DE-9). Up to 7 cameras daisy-chainable

ports.name: RS-232 OUT
ports.note: 8-pin mini-DIN connector (closest listed connector id used; physical connector is mini-DIN, not DE-9). Loops to next camera's RS-232 IN in daisy chain

ports.name: RS-422
ports.note: 9-pin captive screw/terminal-block (Phoenix/euroblock style) connector, included as a detachable accessory. Up to 7 cameras daisy-chainable; mutually exclusive with RS-232 use

ports.name: DC IN 12V
ports.note: EIAJ-04 DC barrel connector, 12V (10.8-13.0V DC), used with included external power adapter/cord. Camera can alternatively be powered via PoE+ over the Ethernet port
